Content:
## FileActions (Semantic Kernel Plugin)

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.Coding.Services`
**Assembly:** `Cyrena.Coding.Extension`

### Purpose
Semantic Kernel plugin providing AI with file CRUD operations. All operations backup to `IVersionControl` before modification.

### Constructor
```csharp
internal class FileActions
{
    public FileActions(IDevelopPlanService plan, IChatMessageService context, IVersionControl version);
}
```

### Kernel Functions

| Function | Description | Parameters |
|----------|-------------|------------|
| `read_file` | Returns full text content | `fileId` |
| `read_lines` | Returns `DevelopFileLines` with line indices | `fileId` |
| `write_content` | Overwrites entire file | `fileId`, `content` |
| `replace_line` | Replaces block of lines | `fileId`, `startIndex`, `count`, `newLines` |
| `append_line` | Appends line to end | `fileId`, `text` |
| `insert_line` | Inserts line after index | `fileId`, `index`, `text` |
| `delete` | Removes file from project | `fileId` |

### Return Types
- `string` for `read_file` (formatted with FILE header)
- `ToolResult<DevelopFileLines>` for line-based operations
- `ToolResult<DevelopFileContent>` for content operations
- `ToolResult` for `delete`

### Error Handling
All functions catch exceptions and return `[ERROR]message[/ERROR]` or `ToolResult(false, message)`.

### ReadOnly Protection
`write_content`, `replace_line`, `insert_line`, and `delete` check `file.ReadOnly` and return error if true.

### Version Control
Before any modification, the current content is backed up:
```csharp
_plan.Plan.TryReadFileContent(file, out var fileContent);
_version.Backup(fileContent);
```
